definition_en: a decorative pin fastened to clothing, often set with jewels
core_image: 一枚镶宝石的别针扣在大衣领口
scene: 祖母打开首饰盒，取出一枚传了三代的银饰针。She fastened the antique brooch on her grey coat.
sceneCN: 这里 brooch 是「胸针」（第 1 个义项：别在衣上的装饰针）；句意是她把那枚古董胸针别在灰色大衣上。

collocations.phrase: wear a brooch at the collar

derivatives.zh: 由 brooch 加 -like 构成，义为「似胸针的（罕用）」
由 brooch 加 -ed 构成，义为「以胸针饰的（罕用）」

senses.title: An ornamental pin
senses.definition: a piece of jewellery with a pin, worn fastened to clothes
senses.definitionCN: 带别针的首饰，扣在衣服上佩戴
senses.example: A cameo brooch held her scarf in place.
senses.exampleCN: 一枚浮雕胸针把她的围巾别住。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the object itself: a pin made beautiful.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是物件本身：一枚做得很美的别针。

senses.title: A clasp or fastening shaped like it
senses.definition: a decorative clasp in the shape or style of a brooch
senses.definitionCN: 形制与胸针相仿的装饰性搭扣
senses.example: The cloak closed with a heavy Celtic brooch.
senses.exampleCN: 斗篷用一枚厚重的凯尔特式扣针扣合。
senses.why: Jewellery began as a fastener, so the old fastening sense survives in cloak and cloak-pin uses.
senses.whyCN: 首饰本源于扣具，古老的扣合之义留在斗篷扣针的用法里。

intro.en: Brooch and broach were once the same word, from Old French broche, a skewer.
intro.cn: brooch 与 broach 本是同一个词，源自古法语 broche（签子、尖杆）。

items.en: brocca meant a pointed tool, from broccus, projecting.
items.cn: 拉丁语 brocca 指尖头工具，一般认为源自 broccus（凸出的）。

items.en: broche meant a skewer or spit, and also a pin-shaped clasp.
items.cn: 古法语 broche 指烤肉签，也指针状搭扣。

items.en: broach named both a skewer and a decorative pin; brooch split off as the jewellery spelling.
items.cn: broach 兼指导管与饰针；brooch 作为首饰义拼式逐渐分离。

items.en: brooch settled as the word for the ornamental pin, keeping the French-style vowel.
items.cn: brooch 定型为胸针之称，保留法语式元音读音。

items.en: brooch now belongs to jewellery; broach means to raise a subject or pierce a cask.
items.cn: 如今 brooch 属首饰，broach 则指提出话题或钻孔开桶。

note.en: Brooch shares a history with broach and sits beside pin and clasp.
note.cn: brooch 与 broach 同源，并与一组扣针词相邻。

entries.definition: to raise a subject; to pierce a cask; once the same word as brooch
entries.definitionCN: 提出（话题）；钻孔——与 brooch 本为一词
破裂；违反——只是发音拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a carved gem often mounted as a brooch
a pin worn to show rank or membership
a hanging ornament worn on a chain
entries.definitionCN: 坠饰，以链佩戴而非别针

normalIntro.en: Remember the twin broach and brooch, split by spelling and meaning.
normalIntro.cn: 记住 broach 与 brooch 这对双生词，由拼法和词义分开。

normal.en: Brooch has oo like the eye of a jewel.
normal.cn: brooch 的 oo 想成宝石的眼。

normal.en: Broach raises topics; brooch raises collars.
normal.cn: broach 提话题，brooch 别衣领。

normal.en: Ouch! The pin pricks: brooch ends in -och.
normal.cn: 哎哟（ouch）！针扎了一下，brooch 以 -och 结尾。

normal.en: A cameo brooch holds the scarf.
Breach is a break; brooch is a pin.
normal.cn: breach 是破裂，brooch 是饰针。

abstract.en: See silver glint at a grey coat collar.
abstract.cn: 看见灰色大衣领口银光一闪。

abstract.en: Feel the cold clasp click shut under the thumb.
abstract.cn: 拇指下感到冰凉的扣针咔哒合上。

abstract.en: Picture three generations of hands opening one jewel box.
abstract.cn: 想象三代人的手先后打开同一只首饰盒。

examples.en: The Queen's pearl brooch was a wedding gift.
examples.cn: 王后的珍珠胸针是一件结婚贺礼。

examples.en: She lost the clasp of her favourite brooch.
examples.cn: 她心爱胸针的搭扣丢了。

examples.en: Celtic brooches once fastened woollen cloaks.
examples.cn: 凯尔特式扣针曾用来扣羊毛斗篷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不露齿」——胸针别得体面，笑也矜持「不露齿」，只露领口一枚针。

root: brooch 与 broach 同源，经古法语 broche（签子、尖杆）上溯拉丁语 brocca（尖器），一般认为与 broccus（凸出的）相关。原指针状物，首饰义分离后拼写分化为 brooch。

sensesIntro.en: From a pointed fastener, the word narrowed to the ornamental pin and its clasp-like kin.
sensesIntro.cn: 从尖头扣具出发，词义收窄为装饰性别针及其扣具用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a jewelled pin clicking shut at the collar.
core.cn: 核心意象：镶宝的别针在领口咔哒扣紧。

intro.en: Brooch is a single-morpheme loanword; its family lives in spelling twins.
intro.cn: brooch 是单语素借词；其词族体现在孪生拼写上。

latinIntro.en: The root runs through French back to Latin brocca.
latinIntro.cn: 词根经法语上溯至拉丁语 brocca。

items.meaning: to raise a subject; to pierce
